```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(jsonlite)
  library(yaml)
})

`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) y else x
rel_to_outdir <- function(path, outdir) {
  if (is.null(path) || !nzchar(path) || is.null(outdir) || !nzchar(outdir)) return(path)
  norm_out <- normalizePath(outdir, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  norm_path <- normalizePath(path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  rel <- sub(paste0("^", gsub("([.\\+\\*\\?\\^\\$\\(\\)\\[\\]\\{\\}\\|])", "\\\\\\1", norm_out), "/?"), "", norm_path)
  file.path("..", rel)
}

logo_path <- normalizePath(
  file.path(knitr::current_input(dir = TRUE), "..", "icon", "Harako-logo.png"),
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = FALSE
)
logo_uri <- if (file.exists(logo_path)) knitr::image_uri(logo_path) else ""
```

```{r branding, results='asis'}
cat("<div style='display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin:0 0 24px;'>")
if (nzchar(logo_uri)) {
  cat(sprintf("<img src='%s' alt='Harako-RNAseq logo' style='width:72px;height:auto;' />", logo_uri))
}
cat("<div>")
cat("<h1 style='margin:0;'>Harako-RNAseq Report</h1>")
cat("<p style='margin:4px 0 0;'>Harako-RNAseq analysis summary</p>")
cat("</div></div>")
```

# Run metadata

```{r}
metadata <- tibble(
  generated_at = Sys.time(),
  outdir = params$outdir
)
metadata
```

# Contrasts (resolved)

```{r}
resolved_path <- file.path(params$outdir, "run", "config_resolved.yaml")
if (file.exists(resolved_path)) {
  cfg <- yaml::read_yaml(resolved_path)
  if (!is.null(cfg$contrast_resolved)) {
    tibble(
      mode = cfg$contrast_resolved$mode %||% "",
      ref = cfg$contrast_resolved$ref %||% ""
    )
    if (!is.null(cfg$contrast_resolved$levels)) {
      cat("Levels:\n")
      print(cfg$contrast_resolved$levels)
    }
    if (!is.null(cfg$contrast_resolved$generated)) {
      cat("Contrasts:\n")
      print(cfg$contrast_resolved$generated)
    }
  } else {
    cat("No contrast_resolved found in config_resolved.yaml.")
  }
} else {
  cat("config_resolved.yaml not found.")
}
```

# fastp summary

```{r}
fastp_files <- list.files(params$fastp_dir, pattern = "\\\\.json$", full.names = TRUE)
if (length(fastp_files) > 0) {
  fastp_tbl <- lapply(fastp_files, function(path) {
    payload <- fromJSON(path)
    tibble(
      sample = gsub("\\\\.json$", "", basename(path)),
      total_reads = payload$summary$before_filtering$total_reads,
      total_bases = payload$summary$before_filtering$total_bases,
      gc_content = payload$summary$before_filtering$gc_content
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  fastp_tbl
} else {
  cat("No fastp JSON files found.")
}
```

# Salmon mapping summary

```{r}
salmon_meta <- list.files(params$salmon_dir, pattern = "meta_info\\\\.json$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
if (length(salmon_meta) > 0) {
  salmon_tbl <- lapply(salmon_meta, function(path) {
    payload <- fromJSON(path)
    tibble(
      sample = basename(dirname(path)),
      mapping_rate = payload$mapping_rate
    )
  }) %>% bind_rows()
  salmon_tbl
} else {
  cat("No salmon meta_info.json files found.")
}
```

# Gene set enrichment

```{r, results='asis'}
enrich_dir <- params$enrichment_dir
status_files <- character(0)
if (!is.null(enrich_dir) && nzchar(enrich_dir) && dir.exists(enrich_dir)) {
  status_files <- list.files(enrich_dir, pattern = "status\\.json$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
  status_files <- sort(status_files)
}

if (length(status_files) == 0) {
  cat("Enrichment: disabled or no status.json found.\n")
} else {
  for (status_path in status_files) {
    contrast_dir <- dirname(status_path)
    contrast_name <- gsub("^contrast=", "", basename(contrast_dir))
    cat(sprintf("<details><summary>%s</summary>\n\n", contrast_name))
    payload <- NULL
    read_ok <- TRUE
    tryCatch({
      payload <- fromJSON(status_path)
    }, error = function(e) {
      read_ok <<- FALSE
      cat(sprintf("Status read failed: %s\n\n", conditionMessage(e)))
    })

    if (read_ok && !is.null(payload)) {
      state <- if (isTRUE(payload$ok)) "OK" else if (isTRUE(payload$skipped)) "Skipped" else "Failed"
      reason <- payload$reason %||% ""
      cat(sprintf("Status: **%s**  \nReason: %s\n\n", state, reason))

      if (!is.null(payload$inputs)) {
        cat("Inputs:\n")
        print(as.data.frame(payload$inputs))
        cat("\n")
      }
      if (!is.null(payload$config)) {
        cat("Config:\n")
        print(as.data.frame(payload$config))
        cat("\n")
      }
      if (!is.null(payload$versions)) {
        cat("Versions:\n")
        print(as.data.frame(payload$versions))
        cat("\n")
      }
    }

    ora_tsv <- file.path(contrast_dir, "ora_go_bp.tsv")
    ora_png <- file.path(contrast_dir, "ora_go_bp_dotplot.png")
    gsea_tsv <- file.path(contrast_dir, "gsea_go_bp.tsv")
    gsea_png <- file.path(contrast_dir, "gsea_go_bp_dotplot.png")

    if (file.exists(ora_tsv)) {
      cat(sprintf("ORA table: [%s](%s)\n\n", basename(ora_tsv), rel_to_outdir(ora_tsv, params$outdir)))
      ora_tbl <- read_tsv(ora_tsv, show_col_types = FALSE)
      knitr::kable(head(ora_tbl, 10))
      cat("\n\n")
    }
    if (file.exists(ora_png)) {
      knitr::include_graphics(ora_png)
      cat("\n\n")
    }

    if (file.exists(gsea_tsv)) {
      cat(sprintf("GSEA table: [%s](%s)\n\n", basename(gsea_tsv), rel_to_outdir(gsea_tsv, params$outdir)))
      gsea_tbl <- read_tsv(gsea_tsv, show_col_types = FALSE)
      knitr::kable(head(gsea_tbl, 10))
      cat("\n\n")
    }
    if (file.exists(gsea_png)) {
      knitr::include_graphics(gsea_png)
      cat("\n\n")
    }

    curve_pngs <- list.files(contrast_dir, pattern = "^gsea_curve_.*\\.png$", full.names = TRUE)
    if (length(curve_pngs) > 0) {
      curve_pngs <- head(curve_pngs, 6)
      knitr::include_graphics(curve_pngs)
      cat("\n\n")
    }

    cat("</details>\n\n")
  }
}
```
